tools.name: find_gyms
tools.description: Find Brazilian jiu-jitsu and grappling gyms by city, by country, or near a point. Give at least one of: city, country, or lat+lng. Returns at most 25 gyms per call (no pagination: narrow the area for more specific results). Each gym has a link to its public page on bjjsquare.com, where contacts and

tools.name: get_gym
tools.description: Public details of one gym by its slug (from find_gyms): address, website, affiliation, what it offers, class schedule when the gym has published one, and when the schedule was last updated. Only known facts are returned: a missing field means unknown, not "no". Phone and email are on the gym page li

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Countries covered by BJJ Square with gym counts, or, with a country code, the cities of that country with gym counts (largest 200). Use it to check coverage before find_gyms.

tools.name: find_competitions
tools.description: Upcoming BJJ and grappling competitions from federation and organizer calendars (IBJJF, AJP, Smoothcomp and others), by country and date range. Returns at most 10 per call with the link to the organizer for registration, plus the BJJ Square calendar page for the full list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_gym · Private data: find_gyms · Public sink: get_gym.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_gym · Private data: find_gyms · Public sink: get_gym

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
